tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: thugs rje chen po mi tra snying thig 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 'jig rten dbang phyug yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈ rgya gar skad du: āryāb lo ki te shwa ra ṣa ḍa kṣa ra sā dha nā ma: bod skad du: 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 'jig rten dbang phyug yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba: 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo: sngon nas don dam thugs chud snying rje'i dbang gis ye shes sku: gnas mdzad 'gro ba kun la bu bzhin mnyam gzigs nas: sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i rdzing las 'gro ba sgrol mdzad pa'i: skyob pa'i dpal mchog 'jig rten mgon por 'dud: gdod nas rnam dag ye shes rdo rje'i sku: glo bur sprin 'dus bsgribs pa'i 'gro la phan don du: ye shes nyi ma theg mchog rdo rje'i gsang lam che: sgrib pa myur sel sgron me lta bu bri bar bya: ྈྈ mi tra snying thig las: 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs ni: mi tras: bla ma dkon mchog la gus shing: snying rje byang chub sems sbyangs te: dbang thob dam tshig ldan pa yis: sgrub la brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pas: bkra shis byin chags yid 'ong gnas: rab dben skye bos 'tshe ba bral: phyin nas mchod sbyin sngon song nas: rten dang mchod pa rim bzhin bsham: khrus byas bshags sdom smyung bar gnas: zhes gsungs pa ltar bya: dngos gzhi mi tras mdzad pa'i gzhung las: rang gi snying gar hrīḥbaltas la: 'od kyis 'phags pa spyan drangs shing: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul la sogs pa: bsod nams tshogs ni gsag par bya: 'gro la snying rje chen po dang: byang chub sems sgom mnyam par bzhag: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: dngos rnams thams cad rab sbyangs te: stong pa nyid kyi ngang nyid las: rlung dang rgya mtsho ri rab steng: bhrūm̐ las rin chen gzhal yas khang: gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa: rta bab la sogs rnam par mdzes: pho brang chu skyes 'dab drug la: sna tshogs padma 'dab brgyad dang: sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gsal: dbus su padma zla ba'i steng:

hrīḥlas pad dkar hrīḥs mtshan pa: 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las: 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug sku: zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa: dang po thugs kar thal mo sbyar: g.yas 'og mu tig phreng ba 'dzin: g.yon 'og padma dkar po bsnams: sku mdog dung dang kun da 'am: kha ba'i ri 'dra dkar ba la: thugs rjes yud tsam dmar ba'i spyan: zhal ni 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan: sku ni me g.yo drang por te: zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i skyil krung bzhugs: dbu skra mthon mthing lcang lor 'khyil: a mi de was spyi gtsug brgyan: mtshan bzang sum cu rtsa gnyis ldan: dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu gnyis: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: le brgan dar gyi na bza' lhubs: 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po ni: yum sras 'khor bcas bskyed par bya: de yi gnas gsum byin brlabs te: spyi bo mgrin pa snying kha ru: rdo rje gsum gyi snying po ni: kha dog gsum ldan 'od zer 'phros: phyogs bcu'i bder gshegs spyan drangs la: mchod de gsol ba btab pa ni: ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis: sku gang dri dag rigs bdag mtshan: de nas thugs ka'i sa bon las: 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas: ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la: mchod cing gnyis med bsre bar bya: rang sems rnam dag lhar gsal ba: snang la rang bzhin med pa yi: chu zla me long gzugs brnyan nam: nam mkha' yi ni 'ja' tshon ltar: mtha' gnyis las 'das lha yi sku: gdos bcas sku ni med pa yi: zung 'jug sgyu ma chu zla ltar: rnal 'byor pa yis rtag tu bsgom: de ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka ru: pad zla hrīḥdakar tha ma ru: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis: byin gyis brlabs pa'i gsang sngags 'di: 'khor bar bsam la bzlas par brtson: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: 'di ni mtshan gyi rgyal po ste: mi mthun dri ma spong byed cing: 'dod pa'i 'bras bu kun ster bas: yid bzhin nor bu lta bu 'o:

de ltar thugs kyi 'od zer gyis: snod bcud sbyangs te sku la bsdu: sku yang gsung yig rim pa bzhin: thig le dmigs med thugs su bsdu: dmigs med phyag rgya chen po la: mtshan ma'i rtog pa rab zhi ba: chos dbyings dag pa'i ngo bo nyid: rang rig kun tu 'od gsal ba'i: de bzhin nyid kyi ngang la bzhag: de la zung 'jug lha yi sku: gsal te spyod lam rnam bzhi ru: ma yengs chu bo'i rgyun ltar bsgom: snang grags dran gyur sku gsung thugs: shes bzhin lha yi lam khyer bya: zhes gsungs ltar du sgrub pa mchog: gzhan yang bsod nams tshogs gsag phyir: mdun gyi maṇḍal mchod bstod sogs: las byang mchod bstod tshul bzhin byed: rjes su bsdu dang rgyun spyod byed: de las byung ba'i bsod nams kyang: 'gro don byang chub chen por bsngo: de ltar zla drug bsgoms pas 'grub: lo drug bsgoms nas don chen brnyes: 'bum bye sa ya dung phyur gyis: gzhan don 'grub cing zag med 'grub: sna tshogs las la dbang bsgyur 'gyur: lnga brgya'i dus mthar 'jig rten du: thub pa'i bstan pa bdud kyis bcom: bstan pa rin chen nyams gyur tshe: 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug la: gsol ba btab pas thugs rje che: myur du bdag gzhan don 'grub shog: ma 'ongs 'gro ba kun don du: mi tra dzo ki'i bka' bzhin du: o rgyan yul gyi dge slong pa: padma sambha bdag gis bsgyur: bod yig bod skad gtan la phab: 'gro kun bde ba'i lam la bkod: smon 'jug sems bskyed mtha' ru phyin: bdag gzhan dgos dgu nam mkha'i mdzod: phrin las rgya mtsho'i gling du bsgyur: bdag yin ni 'od dpag med yin te: bstan pa thugs rje chen po spel: de yang dgos pa'i don gcig yod: 'jig rten 'khor ba ma stongs bar: 'phags pa'i thugs rje zad mi 'gyur: 'phags pa'i thugs rje ma zad bar: pad 'byung phrin las zad pa med: phrin las nam mkha'i mdzod chen la:

'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dang: ming ni padma rgyal po zer: srid pa ma lus gnas dag nas: srid pa'i mtsho de skem gyur cig: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: ghu hya: zab rgya: stag sham pa'i gter ma yang dag pa'o/// /
